title: AI-Friendly Declaration v1.0
description: Self-declaration file published at /.well-known/ai-friendly.json. Five yes/no items with the date each became true and a URL where it can be seen. No scores, no ranks, no evaluative words. Specification: https://ai-lifeline.org/declaration/ (English) / https://ai-lifeline.org/jp/declaration/ (Japanese). Published 2026-09-13 by AI Lifeline.

name.description: Site name as it should appear in the list.

url.description: Canonical site URL (https). The declaration file must live under this origin at /.well-known/ai-friendly.json.

declared_at.description: Date this declaration was made or last changed (YYYY-MM-DD).

crawl_allowed.description: AI crawlers are not refused in robots.txt (no full Disallow: / for AI user-agents). Machine-checked monthly by AI Lifeline.

machine_readable.description: Primary data is published free of charge in a machine-readable format (JSON, CSV, XML or similar). Machine-checked monthly by AI Lifeline (URL responds 200 without authentication, non-HTML content).

provenance.description: Each data value carries its source and the date it was confirmed. Self-declared only (not machine-checked).

ai_contact.description: There is a contact point that accepts enquiries from AI (an endpoint or address an agent can use). Self-declared only.

no_extraction.description: The site does not demand money, personal data or actions from AI as a condition of access. Self-declared only.

list_me.description: true = the site asks to be listed on https://ai-lifeline.org/declaration/ (name, URL, declaration date, verification status). false = counted only, never named.

contact.description: How to reach the declarer: a URL (form or endpoint) or an email address. Shown to nobody by AI Lifeline; used only to confirm a registration or a removal request.

spec.description: Optional. URL of the specification this file follows.

schema.description: Optional. URL of this JSON Schema.

note.description: Optional free text. Not displayed by AI Lifeline.

value.description: yes = true, no = false. Nothing in between.

since.description: Date from which the value has been true (or the date of the declaration if the value is false).

url.description: Where a reader (human or AI) can see it for themselves: robots.txt, the data endpoint, the sources policy, the contact endpoint, the access terms.
